rules: A connection is not a conclusion. Never merge an outlet/producer (may be state-connected) with a downstream personality (may be an unwitting amplifier).
No edge without a citation, except do_not_claim edges which record an absence.
do_not_claim edges are first-class negative findings; render them, never drop or silently upgrade them.
The finding is convergent INDEPENDENT paths terminating in the same Russian state/Kremlin-linked network — not any single chain.

entry_point_sweep.question: Independent pre-Tenet Russian-side entry points into the six creators (bypassing Chen/Tenet)
entry_point_sweep.tim_pool: not_established (influence); near-miss: DIRECT_CONTACT (2016 RT/Sputnik office visit) + PERSONNEL_CONTINUITY (Sputnik->Fairbanks->Pool)
entry_point_sweep.dave_rubin: not_established (influence); near-miss: SHARED_MEDIA_INFRASTRUCTURE (Ora TV -> Rubin; Ora TV -> RT America)
entry_point_sweep.note: 'not_established' is a searched negative, NOT proven zero. Count of established independent entry points = 1 (Southern).
entry_point_sweep.method: Count RUSSIAN_STATE/RUSSIAN_STATE_MEDIA/RUSSIAN_STATE_LINKED_PRIVATE actors with an influence edge INTO a creator, NOT via Chen/Tenet. DIRECT = actor->creator; INTERMEDIARY_MEDIATED = actor->intermediary(s)->creator (no Chen/Tenet).
not_counted: Southern->Dugin (creator->actor INTERVIEW is not a Russia->creator conduit)
RUSSIAN_POLITICAL_ACTOR / RUSSIAN_ORDINARY_PERSON as automatic state origins

near_miss_taxonomy.INFLUENCE: qualifying: Russian actor -> creator via conduit relationship (contract/employment/contribution/funding/recruitment/direction). Counts.
near_miss_taxonomy.DIRECT_CONTACT: proximity only (office visit/meeting); e.g. Pool 2016 RT/Sputnik offices. Does NOT count.
near_miss_taxonomy.PERSONNEL_CONTINUITY: shared personnel across time (Sputnik->Fairbanks->Pool); no demonstrated influence propagation. Does NOT count.
near_miss_taxonomy.SHARED_MEDIA_INFRASTRUCTURE: same producer/vendor touches both sides (Ora TV -> Rubin; Ora TV -> RT America); no directed Russia->creator influence. Does NOT count.

open_questions.question: What was Pool & Fairbanks' 2016 RT/Sputnik office visit FOR? (A journalism/reporting B interview/contributor C RT/Sputnik event D employment/recruitment E ordinary tour/visit F other)
open_questions.upgrades_if: contemporaneous 2016 record shows Pool reporting/contributing/interviewing FOR RT/Sputnik -> upgrade OFFICE_VISIT to CONTRIBUTION => Pool becomes a SECOND direct entry point.
open_questions.kills_if: record shows a tour/event/ordinary journalistic visit -> leave as DIRECT_CONTACT, non-qualifying.
open_questions.targets: 2016 primary/near-primary: archived bios, articles, social posts, videos, event pages, interviews, employment records. Search Fairbanks+Pool together, not Pool alone.

open_questions.question: Did Russian influence (Tenet) EXPLOIT a pre-optimized American amplification system (TPUSA's), rather than build reach itself?
open_questions.upgrades_if: more of the six shown to have run through TPUSA's amplification apparatus pre-Tenet (ambassador/production/event ties) -> strengthens 'Russia coupled to a pre-optimized domestic amplifier'.
open_questions.kills_if: the six's reach traces to unrelated independent channels, not TPUSA's apparatus.
open_questions.current: Documented inside TPUSA's amplification machine pre-Tenet: Benny Johnson (CCO/productions) = 1 of the SIX; plus Lauren Chen (the broker, TPUSA contributor). The other five not established as TPUSA ambassadors in this pass.
open_questions.note: Still NO Russia->TPUSA edge. This tests exploitation-of-domestic-infrastructure, a different architecture from institution-direct penetration.

architecture_distinctions.PERSON_MEDIATED: Russian node -> American PERSON -> American INSTITUTION. Documented: RT -> Chen -> TPUSA. The institution is reached THROUGH a person; the institution itself is not Russian-linked.
architecture_distinctions.INSTITUTION_DIRECT: Russian node -> American INSTITUTION directly (funding/control/org). NOT established for TPUSA. Materially different, stronger claim; do not conflate with person-mediated proximity.
architecture_distinctions.INFRASTRUCTURE_EXPLOITATION: Russian operation plugs into a PRE-EXISTING American amplification system (e.g. TPUSA's influencer machine) that it did not build or control. Documented that the machine exists and Benny/Chen were inside it; NOT documented that Russia directed or used TPUSA. Distinct from PERSON_MEDIATED and INSTITUTION_DIRECT.
architecture_distinctions.CONTENT_HARVEST: Russian operation harvests/rebrands authentic American content for its own distribution (IRA reusing TPUSA memes, 2016). Exploitation of OUTPUT, dead-ended at a content node; not control/funding/coordination of the organization, and not a path to its people.

org_penetration_sweep.turning_point_usa: not_established (direct Russia->TPUSA); present only as PERSON_MEDIATED via Chen. Queries: TPUSA+Russia/RT/FARA/funding/government/influence.

timeline_tpusa_tenet: 2019-02: TPUSA hires Johnson as CCO; launches influencer-media strategy.
2020-21: ambassador/influencer network expands (275 ambassadors, ~70M claimed reach, 2021).
2022: 400+ creators onboarded; explicit cross-promotion + creator training/retreats (Verge).
2022-07: Lauren Chen becomes a TPUSA contributor.
2023-11: Tenet launches with creators already inside this ecosystem.
2024-09: DOJ alleges RT covertly funded/directed Tenet.

russian_interaction_modes.2016_CONTENT_HARVEST: IRA harvested/rebranded authentic TPUSA content for its own distribution (IRA -> tpusa_content). Exploitation of output; no org relationship.
russian_interaction_modes.2021_2024_COUPLING: RT personnel/organizational coupling: RT -> Chen (contribution) -> Tenet -> existing creator network. Founder-level access to people embedded in the ecosystem.
russian_interaction_modes.finding: Same American information ecosystem, two fundamentally different Russian interaction modes, ~5-8 years apart. Russia did not create the network in either case; in 2016 it exploited authentic content, later it coupled at the founder level.
